CustomField.label: Schema
CustomField.description: OpenAI-style function-calling tool definition (JSON), precomputed by ApexAgentToolSchemaRegenQueueable from the tool's Apex Action. Populated automatically after insert or after Apex_Class_Name__c changes, and on demand via the Regenerate Schema quick action. Left unchanged when the most recent generation attempt failed, so a prior valid schema is never overwritten with a broken one. History-tracked like this object's other fields; note Long Text Area history records only that the value changed, not its full before/after text.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Precomputed tool definition JSON used by the agent loop. Read-only — use the Regenerate Schema quick action to refresh it after changing the Apex class.
